automatic_fireworks_main_integration.limits: Actual root, automatic scheduler, credits, controls, climate and sound/session/mixer. Deterministic window clock/random. External effects scene notifications, decoder primitives and album transport controlled. No GUI, real compositor rendering or real audio asserted.

independent_gait_review: Both Seoul .066 right/left walks visibly showed support frame 4 for the final eight 16ms samples before settling
Same-heading retarget immediately preserved position and visible frame
No added timers, RAF loops, path extension or post-stop walking
Existing ball-contact, bed-hop and trot suspension handling preserved
checks.bounded_phase_regression: Grid of 16 carried phases, five travel distances and two frame counts validates continuous initial phase and positive local cadence within 0.65–1.35 nominal; a clipped short route explicitly does not force the support frame.
checks.readme: Updated current scene, interactions, fireworks, album music, guestbook, development and deployment; six local document links checked.

visual_evidence.kind: Offline native Canvas and current sprite paw-window alpha measurements; not Chrome
visual_evidence.limits: Alpha bounds include fur, not anatomical contact proof. Rigid Y registration improves paw contact height but does not remove sprite shape variation or foot slide.

limitations: Official Codex Computer Use failed: Sky Computer Use native pipe startup failed. No alternative GUI provider was used; actual Chrome playback and browser frame performance remain unverified.
Short paths and some carried phases intentionally receive only partial support-frame adjustment to retain the cadence cap.
